title.narrative: ECOnomic inclusion and empowerment of Women, Youth and LGBTQ+ community members in three climate vulnerable communities in rural South Africa (ECOWYL)

description.narrative:
Overall Objective (OO): is to increase the economic empowerment and financial inclusion of rural women, youth and LGBTQ+ community members through improving their access to, and decision-making authority over, communal grazing land, livestock and entrepreneurship opportunities in three climate vulnerable districts of rural South Africa.

Specific Objective 1 (SO1): Rural women, youth and LGBTQ+ community members are empowered in making decisions about, and managing their safe participation in, rural economic activities.

Specific Objective 2 (SO2): Rural women, youth and LGBTQ+ community members are represented on communal and/or municipal grazing land governance structures and have access to financial resources either through livestock farming, job opportunities or participation in SMMEs.

Specific Objective 3 (SO3): Men participating in rural land and economic development governance structures have a greater understanding of the barriers facing rural women, youth and LGBTQ+ community members who wish to participate in rural land governance and benefit from traditionally male dominated rural economic activities.

Specific Objective 4 (SO4): Knowledge about the barriers faced by rural women, youth and LGBTQ+ community members in their efforts to safely and equitably participate in green transition value chains is disseminated beyond the targeted 3 climate vulnerable districts of rural South Africa to multiply the benefits and increase the sustainability of the Action
